fusions.name: Fang Tap
fusions.desc: A quick glancing tap that deals 4 poison damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Strike
fusions.desc: A lunging blow on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Warm Side
fusions.desc: When a condition on you expires, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
